**📅 September 25, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bearish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Historic bond rout: 30-year Treasury yields at highest since 2004, 10-year near 5.2%, crushing rate-sensitive assets and pushing mortgage rates above 7%
• Fed re-hawkishness: Officials signal another pre-election hike is likely, repricing the terminal rate higher and killing the soft-landing narrative
• Oil/diesel inflation shock: Iran war risk and potential U.S. diesel export ban threaten to reignite goods and food inflation even as crude whipsaws on Hormuz diplomacy
• Fragile equity leadership: Narrow AI/mega-cap strength props up headline indexes while small caps, housing, and industrials buckle under soaring real rates

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• Financial system "breakage" from the fastest rate-rise cycle in decades (EM carry trade unwind, housing freeze, credit stress)
• Iran/Hormuz geopolitical tail risk and a diesel ban-driven food price spiral

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
A historic bond selloff and resurgent inflation shocks are overwhelming narrow equity resilience, driving cross-asset volatility expansion and acute macro tail-risk.
